name: Performance Investigation
description: Bounded performance investigation using durable tasks, evidence, waits, and effects.

stages.title: Reproduce and benchmark: {goal}
stages.description: Reproduce {goal}. Capture representative workload, repeats, variance, and baseline commands. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Baseline includes workload, environment, revision, and repeatable measurements

stages.title: Profile bottlenecks: {goal}
stages.description: Profile the baseline without changing shared code. Rank bottlenecks and cite artifacts.

stages.title: Investigate alternatives: {goal}
stages.description: Independently investigate alternative explanations and define tests that could disprove them.

stages.title: Choose and implement improvement: {goal}
stages.description: Act as the integration owner. Compare both findings, explain contradictions, implement a bounded candidate, and benchmark it. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Chosen change resolves conflicting findings and has comparative measurements

stages.title: Verify improvement and regressions: {goal}
stages.description: Independently run `{test_command}` and the same benchmark workload. Prepare a PR with evidence only if a safe improvement exists. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Final artifact compares the exact delivered revision with the baseline and records remaining gaps
